summary: Full-stack regression of Conactivos HR after redesign + Google Auth integration. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (email/password login, /auth/me, new /auth/session Google endpoint with invalid session_id -> 401 and missing field -> 422, dashboard/absent, dashboard/birthdays, dashboard/employee-of-month, goals, capsules, kudos, leave-requests). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844: (1) Splash screen displays green #122c2a background with white Conactivos logo for ~1.5s. (2) Login screen shows 'Bienvenido' title, all four testIDs present and visible (email-input, password-input, submit-login-btn, google-login-btn). (3) Email/password login with admin1@conactivos.com works and lands on Home. (4) Home overview shows 'Hola, María' greeting, 'EMPLEADO DEL MES' hero card with Juan Pérez / Desarrollador Senior, Ausentes (1) and Cumpleaños (0) grid, Meta comercial with progress bar (65% $325K/$500K), Permisos (1) and Reconocimientos (6) grid, Cápsula del día card. (5) Bottom tab bar is floating and shows ONLY icons (no text labels) - confirmed visually. (6) All 6 tab titles correct: home 'Hola, María', /kudos -> 'Reconocimientos' (no 'Kudos' text anywhere), /solicitudes -> 'Permisos', /calendario -> 'Eventos', /metas -> 'Metas', /capsulas -> 'Cápsulas'. (7) Alternating background scheme confirmed via screenshots: Home gray, Reconocimientos dark green, Permisos gray, Eventos dark green, Metas gray, Cápsulas dark green. (8) Google Auth button click correctly navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=... (Emergent-managed OAuth) without crashes. No React Native red-screen or page errors observed. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch absent).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:73 (logo tintColor in styles) and /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:230 (logo tintColor in styles). Non-blocking but should migrate to props.tintColor to be forward-compatible.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - originates from a component (likely inside a library or SafeAreaView usage). Non-blocking. Verify no direct pointerEvents prop in project code; if from library, update the library.

action_items: (Low priority) Migrate Image tintColor from StyleSheet to props.tintColor in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/login.tsx to silence RN deprecation warning.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/session correctly validates Emergent session_id against demobackend.emergentagent.com, restricts access to existing registered users (403), and issues a JWT - implementation follows the Emergent Google Auth pattern.
Splash screen (index.tsx) enforces minimum 1.5s display time before redirect, providing consistent branding.
Tab bar (_layout.tsx) uses tabBarShowLabel: false and floating rounded container - clean minimalist design as requested.
Login screen uses Platform.OS branching for alert (window.alert on web, inline error on native) - consistent with previous fix pattern.
